narrative.data_gaps_md:
Transparent documentation of evidence gaps builds assessment credibility and guides the internal discovery process. This section identifies capability areas where evidence coverage was insufficient for high-confidence scoring, the specific data that would resolve the gap, and the scoring implication if the gap were closed.
Public-mode assessments are limited to externally observable evidence. The 8 gaps below represent the highest-value internal discovery questions for an ANBTX engagement kickoff. In each case, the gap does not invalidate the scoring; it bounds confidence and identifies where internal discussion would either confirm the current score or reveal a higher (or lower) maturity level.
